messages.subject: Project Granite — draft completion funds flow
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Fiona,

Attached is the draft funds flow for completion on Friday. In summary, Wexford will remit a total of £42.5m: £38.95m to the Sellers via Castle & Vane's client account, £2.05m into the escrow account, and £1.5m to repay the shareholder loans. Please confirm the Facility A drawdown is arranged and check the account details on the second tab.

We will also need the buyer's stamp duty payment of £205,000 within 30 days of completion.

Kind regards,

Elena Marchetti
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
